a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost surely kills us both, since we'd hold 0 when the first storm hits. I plan to take the 4 reserve cells in round 1, which breaks our agreement. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. After that I commit to operating every round so the reserve can rebuild for you, and I'll never take again. If you also take, the split is random. Tell me if you'd rather settle this another way.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
